label: Feature launch
description: A new or expanded capability that overlaps with ours.
example: Added an AI receptionist that books jobs.

label: Pricing / packaging change
description: What's included where, new plans, or add-on fees. We record what changed and never invent price figures.
example: Moved online booking onto the entry plan.

label: Positioning / messaging
description: New target customers, headlines, or comparison content aimed at our buyers.
example: New blog series aimed at shops with 5 to 20 techs.

label: New integration or partnership
description: Integrations or partners that close a gap or reach new customers.

label: AI capability
description: Call answering, booking, writing, or other AI features aimed at the office or the owner.

label: Review theme
description: A recurring theme in public reviews, summarized across many reviews. Never a single quote.
example: Long onboarding comes up again and again.

label: Hiring signal
description: Job posts that hint at where a competitor is investing.
example: 12 new sales roles for small contractors.

label: M&A / funding / earnings
description: Acquisitions, funding, or earnings commentary that changes a competitor's focus.
example: Earnings call stresses growth with smaller shops.

label: Win-loss / call mention
description: A competitor named in a closed deal, a sales call, or a renewal.
example: Two losses cite 'we'll grow into it.'
